title: National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission Democratic Scorecard

dimensions.evidence: Strictly enforces Article 20(1) immunity against ex post facto criminal penalization and Article 21 due process.
dimensions.uncertainty: Requires vigilant judicial supervision against political misuse.
dimensions.corrective_action: Statutory right of appeal to Supreme Court under Section 11.

dimensions.evidence: Applies objective valuation and recruitment criteria equally without political discrimination.
dimensions.uncertainty: Varying complexity of asset valuations across sectors.
dimensions.corrective_action: Independent valuation panel composed of certified economic experts.

dimensions.evidence: Establishes judicially led Commission with annual reporting duties to Parliament.
dimensions.uncertainty: Administrative delay in complex civil litigation before High Courts.
dimensions.corrective_action: Mandatory 180-day statutory timeline for High Court petitions.

dimensions.evidence: Tripartite selection committee (PM, Opposition Leader, CJI) prevents executive capture.
Mandates open-access portal publishing all audit determinations and court petitions within 14 days.
dimensions.uncertainty: Commercially sensitive trade secret claims by private contracting parties.
dimensions.corrective_action: In-camera judicial inspection for genuine trade secrets.

dimensions.evidence: Direct civil court powers and statutory standing to file High Court quashing/recovery suits.
dimensions.uncertainty: Interstate jurisdictional variance in land records.
dimensions.corrective_action: Special Division Benches designated in each High Court.

dimensions.evidence: Multilingual summaries, accessible digital portal, and plain-language public materials.
60-day public consultation plan with Joint Parliamentary Committee civic hearings.
dimensions.uncertainty: Public awareness of technical asset valuation methodologies.
